body.name: selector-specific high-level SCM
body.construction: For input \(s\), define \(\mathcal M_{H,s}\) with common exogenous variables \(U_C,U_X,B,S\), common law \(P_R\), endogenous variables \(C,H,Z_s,Y\), and equations \(C=U_C\), \(H=h\), \(Z_s=g_s(C,S)\), and \(Y=B_{C,\delta_X(H,Z_s)}\). The observed high-level coordinates are \(C,H,Y\), while \(Z_s\) is the residual coordinate supplied in a partial projection. The intervention \(\operatorname{do}(H=h)\) replaces only the equation for \(H\) by the constant \(h\), retaining \(P_R\) and the equations for \(C,Z_s,Y\).
